about: What Griha's theme engine can draw. A theme lists the features it requires; the catalogue only publishes themes whose requirements are all in a released engine. Griha will export this file from each release once the theme engine ships; until then it is kept here by hand.

glossary.palette.v1: Light and dark palettes: background, surface, accent, secondary, ink, muted, plus onSurface and named extras.
glossary.depth.shadows: Stacked drop shadows and highlights per role (card, key, field, primary).
glossary.depth.inner: Inner shadows: pressed-in fields and the pressed state.
glossary.depth.rim: A gradient edge, lit at the top.
glossary.depth.lip: A solid side under the face, like a key; presses sink into it.
glossary.depth.gloss: A white sheen over the top of a surface.
glossary.depth.glow: Coloured light around a surface while it glows, is focused or pressed.
glossary.depth.outline: A bold ink outline, like a sticker or a cartoon cell.
glossary.depth.flare: A bright streak of light along a glossy edge while hovered or focused.
glossary.state.colours: A different fill per state: default, hover, focus, pressed, busy, done.
glossary.backdrop.light: A soft wash of light from one side.
glossary.backdrop.grid: Hairline columns and rows, as on a styleguide.
glossary.backdrop.haze: Large soft blobs of colour behind see-through panes.
glossary.backdrop.vignette: A darker edge around a lit middle.
glossary.backdrop.blob: An organic shape in a second colour, flowing from one edge.
glossary.backdrop.chrome: Out-of-focus polished metal discs at the edges of the page.
glossary.decor.peel: A panel over the page whose corner folds back, as a page backdrop (backdrop kind "peel").
glossary.wall.picture: A picture behind home and all apps, drawn by Griha.
glossary.wall.motion: The picture drifts with scrolling and leans toward the finger.
glossary.touch.bloom: A tap sends out a soft white bloom.
glossary.touch.ring: A tap sends out a thin ring.
glossary.touch.glow: A tap sends out a warm glow.
glossary.touch.ripple: A tap sends out glass ripples in turning tints.
glossary.touch.embers: A tap throws a few embers.
glossary.widget.ring: Circular gauges with a track and a lit arc (battery, clock seconds).
glossary.widget.well: A deep circular well pressed into the page, holding the clock.
glossary.widget.pill-week: The week as a pill with today and marked days raised in white boxes.
glossary.type.vertical: Text set sideways along the edge.
glossary.headings.style: Section headings: capitals, letter spacing, weight.
glossary.icons.shape: Icon shapes: original, circle, squircle, teardrop.
glossary.icons.plate: A coloured plate behind each icon.
glossary.icons.mono: Single-colour icons where the app provides one.
glossary.icons.dot: A coloured dot instead of an icon, from the theme's dot colours.
glossary.icons.badge: Mono icons on a solid round badge.
glossary.font.system: Android's own font families, such as sans-serif-black.
glossary.font.bundled: Fonts shipped inside a theme package.
glossary.home.blocks: The theme's own home: a list of blocks (clock cards, gauges, panels, app styles, docks, bars) laid out top to bottom.
glossary.widget.meters: Tall outlined meters for battery and music volume.
glossary.lock.theme: The lock screen in the theme's colours and lettering, with the theme's picture or page when the user has no lock design of their own.
glossary.lock.subject: A light, optional styling of the lock photo's subject in the theme's colour: colour wash, duotone, edge light or halo. The photo itself is never changed.
glossary.lock.clock: The theme's clock piece on the lock screen, in a date edition: Android's own clock keeps the time above it.
